_comment: Keys starting with '_' are ignored. `init` copies this to %LOCALAPPDATA%\meeting2jira\config.json. See README > Configuration reference.

jira._base_url: Jira Data Center only. Authentication is always a personal access token (Profile > Personal Access Tokens), stored with `set-token`.

filters._exclusions: Plain case-insensitive substrings; edit these freely. They match inside words, so use skip_subject_patterns below when you need word boundaries (e.g. PTO vs OPTOMETRIST).
filters._skip_subject_patterns: Regular expressions, for anchors and word boundaries.

_tour_of_duty: Your scheduled working hours, local time. This classifies meetings; it does NOT decide which days are scanned (that is -DaysBack, and re-runs cannot duplicate). A meeting entirely outside your tour triggers outside_action; one that merely runs past the end counts as inside, so work is never dropped.

tour_of_duty._outside_action: include = treat it normally | label = add outside_label | route = put it under outside_parent (e.g. a comp-time issue) | skip = exclude it

_rules: First match wins. Each rule routes to a parent or skips. Unmatched meetings go to jira.default_parent. Note: an outside-tour meeting with outside_action 'route' or 'skip' is handled before rules.
